# Reverend Ez

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Theology student and minister  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mr. Hale  <sub>[v3 c24 P21](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0021)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Ezra  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>; Ez  <sub>[v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

He is described as an extremely unattractive young man with a large, gangly frame and ridiculous, elongated legs. He has flaxen, limp hair that conceals a scholarly forehead on ordinary days, green eyes, a large mouth, and large ears. In the moonlight, or while preaching with his impassioned eyes, he appears less plain.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015)_

## Personality

He possesses a delightful voice and a soul of unquestionable beauty and nature. Serious, gentle, faithful, and dedicated, he embodies all that a clergyman should be. He enjoys laughing and joking, and he provides clear, practical advice to those who are confused.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c27 P25](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0025)_

- to fulfill the clerical labor assigned to him with the assistance of God  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)</sub>

## History

Ezra studied theology at St. Columbia after graduating from Wexcombe. Over one summer, he took charge of the Prospect Point Mission Church, where he stayed at a select boardinghouse owned by Cousin Emily. During his time at Prospect Point, he became close friends with Cressida Lindsay, accompanying her fishing, boating, and strolling along the shore. Although he initially resisted entering the ministry, he embraced his destiny to become a clergyman. He delivered a splendid, moving sermon at the village church that profoundly influenced Cressy. Following the completion of his studies at St. Columbia, he arranged to take over a small mission church on Tanner Street in the slums and got engaged to Cressy, setting their wedding for a year from the coming June.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)_

## Quotes

> I attempted to be a different person for a extended period—I lacked the desire to be a clergyman. However, I eventually realized that it was the labor assigned to me—and with the assistance of God, I will endeavor to fulfill it.  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)</sub>
